name: @ahpd/services
description: A machine's services for ahpd: the process-compose driver, and the machine-local switches only the machine can set.

ahpd.title: Services
ahpd.description: This machine's programs under process-compose: list, change the machine's own file, start, stop, restart and read logs, with drift alerts.

files.description: process-compose's -f files as absolute paths, in the order it is given them. Only the last (the machine's own) is written.

socket.description: Absolute path of process-compose's Unix socket (its -u). Never TCP.

tokenFile.description: Absolute path of the file holding process-compose's API token (its --token-file).

changeLog.description: Absolute path of the JSONL change log. Default: <configDir>/services/changes.jsonl.

machine.description: The machine's name as messages say it. Default: the host name.
